note: A sample screen change request in the shape Orac (A2) will file. Orac is not connected; this is a fixture and is labelled as such on screen.

request.author: orac
request.asked: Give the players a bridge screen for the approach, with the target's key facts and a bit of mood.
request.rationale: I combined four views from the stack: the chart, a card on the selected body, a hazard light and the plain prose voice. It uses the campaign's data view, so players see only what they have scanned. No code was written; this is a layout document you can edit by hand.
